title: Digital First GTM Strategy
subtitle: AI-Powered Demo Intelligence & On-Demand Personalization
executiveSummary: The future of enterprise sales demands AI-powered, prospect-centric engagement. By leveraging AI to understand prospect intent, automatically assemble tailored narratives, and deliver on-demand interactive experiences, we eliminate friction in the buyer journey while capturing rich telemetry that guides sellers to focus on high-value conversations. This isn't just operational efficiency—it's a [[highlight]]fundamental competitive advantage[[/highlight]].

outlook: Prospects engage on their terms, at their pace, with content that speaks directly to their business challenges. The [[metric]]37% efficiency gain[[/metric]] is proof of concept; the real opportunity is transforming how we demonstrate value to prospects [[highlight]]before the first human conversation[[/highlight]]. AI gives us the ability to be everywhere, always relevant, infinitely scalable—turning demos from a cost center into an [[positive]]intelligent revenue engine[[/positive]] that learns and improves with every interaction. This Digital-First strategy isn't optional—it's the [[highlight]]price of admission for enterprise sales leadership[[/highlight]] in 2026 and beyond.
